newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CCB SAYS BEL-20 CAN REACH 2000 BY END 1997.
newsitem.headline: CCB SAYS BEL-20 CAN REACH 2000 BY END 1997.

text.p: The Bel-20 index of leading Belgian shares could reach the level of 2,000 points by the end of next year, Belgian publicly-owned bank Credit Communal/Gemeentekrediet (CCB) said in a study on Tuesday.

The bank said that the Brussels bourse is among the cheapest in Europe. It added that record low interest rates, a record low yield premium of Belgian bonds over equivalent German bonds and a recovery of the U.S. dollar should all contribute to lifting the index towards the 2,000 point level.
On Tuesday, the index closed at 1778.05 points, after briefly breaking above 1,800 for the first time late last week.
